For over 20 years, the winning team of Rob & Lee have rustled up heart-warming meals that are made with the freshest of quality ingredients and time-trusted recipes that have been with the family for generations.

The home-grown entrepreneur couple hold the reins to the immensely popular Good to Go Take Away housed on North East Road in St Agnes.

With a passion for cooking that brought them together and continues to stir the pots in the kitchen, Rob & Lee offer an exhaustive menu that dishes out a smorgasbord of options.

From plump burgers to loaded ‘Schnittys’, perfectly crispy fried chicken to anytime ‘brekkie’ meals, ‘Sub’ rolls to saucy and loaded fries, the Good to Go Takeaway promises a lip-smacking treat.

Lee, who is also a certified chef, prides over an immaculately hygienic kitchen. “We cook as though we are cooking for our own family,” says Lee who shares the ingredients to her secret sauce – “lots of passion, love and care”.
